messages:
Maria C: heads-up — docs-scan flagged a redirect bounce loop and three onboarding images returning 403 on /getting-started. attaching excerpt. @Lena (infra) any idea if the shortlink rewrite went out yesterday?

less context: I only noticed it because QA hit a 301 loop while testing the new quickstart flow.

docs-bot: scan-results: 3 broken images (403), 2 redirect loops (301->302->301), affected pages: /getting-started, /quickstart/auth, /runtime/cli. Full report: https://internal/reports/scan/3192467999 :warning:

AJ: Was there a config change yesterday? I remember a shortlink rollout around 17:00.

Maria C: Yes — I merged a small redirect change to shortlinks.yaml late-afternoon. I only intended to add one alias but looks like two entries conflict and produced a circular mapping.

Sam B: I'll take a look. If it's just redirect entries we can fix + redeploy quickly. @Kevin P do we have a hotfix process for shortlink updates or should I open a normal PR?

Kevin P: Hotfix is fine. Sam, ping me when you have a PR. Also run a quick local check with `rg` before merging to avoid more orphan aliases.

Sam B: On it. Local test plan:
```bash
# find conflicting shortlinks
rg "^alias:\\"" shortlinks.yaml -n || true
# preview file
sed -n '1,120p' shortlinks.yaml
# staging deploy
./scripts/deploy-shortlinks.sh --staging
```

AJ: I can review the PR. Small nit: add a changelog entry and rehost any images that keep 403ing (looks like they were on the old CDN path).

Sam B: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — change is tiny (remove conflicting alias + rehost two images under /assets/onboarding/). CI initially flagged a missing frontmatter key on /getting-started.md, fixed that in the PR.

docs-bot: queued re-run of scan for 3192468010, status: pending

Maria C: assigning ownership to Sam B for this thread — please update once the hotfix is live. :thumbsup:

Sam B: Will update. Expecting to finish deploy + smoke tests within 30m.

docs-bot: scan completed for 3192468010 — no redirect loops found, 0 403s on the previously affected pages. :white_check_mark:

Maria C: amazing, thanks everyone. Leaving a short changelog note: 'docs: fix onboarding shortlink mapping and rehost images to /assets/onboarding/'.

Sam B: Done — PR merged and deployed to prod. Closing thread. :rocket:
